description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Exception' in the Opencart\\Catalog\\Controller\\Error namespace. The class extends a system engine controller and provides an 'index' method to handle exception display, including loading language resources, setting page title, constructing breadcrumbs, and rendering the error view.

classes.name: Exception
classes.description: Controller class for handling exception errors within the OpenCart catalog, displaying an error page with breadcrumb navigation, header, footer, and main content.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to handle the display of an exception error page, setting the page title, breadcrumbs, and rendering the error view.
